page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.48xlarge is an extra-large general-purpose instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 processor architecture. Compute capacity is delivered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz, providing 192 dedicated virtual cores. System memory totals 1024 GB, yielding an allocation ratio of 5.33 GB per vCPU. This configuration provides extensive capacity for workloads that demand both dense multi-threaded compute and large contiguous memory spaces within a single virtual machine boundary.

From an architectural and connectivity perspective, the instance is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, enabling high throughput for data-intensive communication. Local storage is not included on the instance, meaning all file systems, databases, and persistent logs must reside on network-attached storage volumes. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated GPU acceleration hardware, focusing its full resource footprint on central processing tasks.

In terms of qualitative resource efficiency, ecs.g8i.48xlarge consolidates extensive memory and high-core-count CPU resources into a single system unit. This structure reduces operational complexity compared to orchestrating horizontal clusters of smaller instances, while maximizing core-to-memory density. The primary operational tradeoffs lie in its dependence on external storage and the absence of specialized hardware accelerators. The instance is suited for enterprise resource planning platforms, large in-memory caching systems, large build and CI/CD pipelines, and high-throughput web serving infrastructure.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.48xlarge is a high-density, general-purpose server instance powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1024 GB of system memory, it provides a balanced allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance includes a 100 Gbps baseline network interface to sustain heavy cross-node and service traffic. There is no bundled local storage and no discrete hardware accelerator attached, requiring data persistence to be managed via remote cloud block storage solutions. Delivering substantial parallel compute capacity alongside massive system memory, the instance provides qualitative resource efficiency for centralized architectures without requiring distributed cluster management overhead. The ecs.g8i.48xlarge is appropriate for large-scale enterprise software deployments, high-concurrency web serving tiers, in-memory databases, and compute-intensive batch processing pipelines.
